createSubtitle: You can add more businesses later, and switch between them.
name: Business name
typeHint: This only chooses the starting categories and chart of accounts.
welcomeBody: Your business is ready. The screens for accounts, transactions and reports arrive in the next steps.
settingsSubtitle: Details, preferences and status for this business.
readOnlyRole: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
currencyHint: Can't change once the books have entries.
fiscalLocked: Set when the business was created. It can't change, because the financial periods are built around it.
preferencesHint: How this business writes money, numbers and dates.
localeHint: Each person still chooses their own screen language.
statusHintACTIVE: The business is in use. Pausing or archiving makes it read-only; you can undo either.
statusHintINACTIVE: Paused: everything can be seen but nothing can change.
statusHintARCHIVED: Archived: kept for the record, read-only.
confirmACTIVE: {{name}} will be open for changes again.
confirmINACTIVE: {{name}} becomes read-only for everyone until it's reactivated.
confirmARCHIVED: {{name}} becomes read-only for everyone and moves to the bottom of your list. You can reactivate it later.
next95: Step 9.5: ledger, chart of accounts and closing months
limitBody_one: The {{plan}} plan has room for {{count}} business. Upgrade to Pro to run several side by side, or archive one you no longer use.
limitBody_other: The {{plan}} plan has room for {{count}} businesses. Upgrade for more, or archive one you no longer use.
dataHint: Download everything this business holds as one Excel file: accounts, transactions, customers and suppliers, items, invoices and bills, the journal, budgets, goals and tasks. Uploaded files stay in Documents.
